title: Specification Overfitting in Artificial Intelligence
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. This paper is a literature survey on the methodological problem of 'specification overfitting' and does not conduct any new benchmark measurements, religious or otherwise.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. It is a literature survey analyzing how AI research papers handle the problem of 'specification overfitting', where systems focus excessively on specified metrics (like fairness or robustness) to the detriment of high-level requirements.
